contract.title: Will the average U.S. 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rate for Sep 24, 2026 be above 7.01%?
contract.rules:
If the average U.S. 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rate for Sep 24, 2026 is above 

7.01%, then the market resolves to Yes.

The Underlying is the 30-Year Fixed-Rate Mortgage national average published by Freddie Mac in its Primary Mortgage Market Survey (PMMS) for Sep 24, 2026.

For a standard Thursday publication, the weekly measurement period runs from 12:00 a.m. ET on the preceding Thursday through 11:59 p.m. ET on Wednesday. The resulting national average is published Thursday at 12:00 p.m. ET. This market will use Freddie Mac's first published PMMS value for the specified week. Subsequent corrections or revisions made after expiration will not affect resolution.
contract.resolution_source: See frozen Kalshi rules and series contract.

contract.title: Will more than 2300000 people be **screened by the TSA** on average this week?
contract.rules:
If weekly average TSA airport screenings are above 2.3 million for the week ending September 20, 2026, according to the TSA, then the market resolves to Yes.

The Contract will expire at the sooner of the first 9:00 AM following the release of the data for September 20, 2026, or one week after September 20, 2026. The Last Trading Date and Time will always be 11:59 PM on September 20, 2026.
contract.resolution_source: See frozen Kalshi rules and series contract.

contract.title: Will average **gas prices** be above $4.4000?
contract.rules: If average regular gas prices for United States are strictly greater than $4.4000 on Sep 21, 2026 according to AAA, then the market resolves to Yes.
contract.resolution_source: See frozen Kalshi rules and series contract.

contract.title: Will US housing starts for September 2026 be above 1.300M?
contract.rules:
If US housing starts for September 2026 is above 1.300M, then the market resolves to Yes.

The Underlying is the "Housing Starts" figure reported in the U.S. Census Bureau’s New Residential Construction release for September 2026 (as displayed on Trading Economics). If the September 2026 release is delayed or rescheduled, the market will resolve based on the first official publication of the September 2026 Housing Starts value.
contract.resolution_source: See frozen Kalshi rules and series contract.

contract.title: How many launches will Rocket Lab Corporation have after June 29, 2026 at 4:00pm ET and before Jan 2027?
contract.rules:
If Rocket Lab Corporation has Above 10 launch after June 29, 2026 at 4:00pm ET and before Jan 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

For the purpose of this market, HASTE missions will not count.

contract.title: Will 2026 be the hottest year on record?
contract.rules:
If the unsmoothed Land-Ocean Temperature Index value for 2026 reported by NASA’s Goddard Institute for Space Studies (GISS) is above the 2025 value and 1.28 degrees Celsius, then the market resolves to Yes.

The market will close at 11:59 PM ET on December 31, 2026. The market will expire at the sooner of the first 10:00 AM following the release of the data for 2026, or 10:00 AM ET April 01, 2027
contract.resolution_source: See frozen Kalshi rules and series contract.

contract.title: Will the maximum temperature be 88-89° on Sep 19, 2026?
contract.rules:
If the maximum temperature recorded at Miami (CLIMIA) for Sep 19, 2026, is between 88-89° fahrenheit according to The Weather Company, then the market resolves to Yes.

Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market is the maximum/minimum temperature as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Preliminary Weather Company data may be subject to rounding and conversion differences from the final reported value.
Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.

If it is determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange that there is a material error in the initial non-preliminary publication, Expiration may be held until the publication of a non-materially-erroneous data revision or until the Expiration Date, whichever comes first. If no data is available at the end of this period, all markets will resolve to the last fair price determined by Kalshi. Please note, a status of "Final" on weather.com/kalshi is provided for convenience only, and does not guarantee data to be error-free and thus exempt from the above.
contract.resolution_source: See frozen Kalshi rules and series contract.

contract.title: Will the extent of the Arctic sea ice be below 4.2 million square km between December 19, 2025 and October 01, 2026?
contract.rules:
If the National Snow & Ice Data Center records a day between December 19, 2025 and October 01, 2026 where the extent of arctic sea ice is below 4.2 million square kilometers, then the market resolves to Yes.

The Underlying is the lowest individual daily Extent value reported in the NSIDC Sea Ice Index Version 4 Northern Hemisphere daily CSV for a date within between December 19, 2025 and October 01, 2026, measured in millions of square kilometers.
contract.resolution_source: See frozen Kalshi rules and series contract.

rationale: One threshold per event, chosen from price-free definitions to broaden domains; no NFL, no re-use of earlier events. No replacements after screening.
